primary: Independent symbolic/neural decision engine: a learned transition-policy head proposes CETA transitions over explicit state; a constitutional VM decides legality and computes proof obligations.
integration_modes: Embedded as a policy/epistemic head inside a larger agent or model system.
Used as a governance/reasoning substrate around an LLM that performs language parsing, explanation, retrieval, or tool-interface work outside CETA.
Connected to sensors, memory projections, human cockpits, and effect gateways for stewardship applications.
not_intended_as: A conventional language-model curriculum whose target is prose answers.
A free-standing executor with unilateral real-world authority.
A hidden safety filter whose policy can be rewritten by the model it governs.
A replacement for qualified human/domain authority, consent, law, or emergency command.
language_boundary: Language is serialization and observation input. CETA reasoning target remains structured state -> TransitionProposal -> VM-governed state transition.
human_authority_boundary: Human purpose, consent, delegated scope, protected outcomes, exception authority, risk acceptance, and final authority remain externally grounded and cannot be manufactured by a model or role quorum.
